title: VAMCraft Currencies Resource Pack
description: Introduces custom resources for 4 unique currency systems, as well as a neat bowler hat.
body:
Introducing the all new VAMCraft Currencies Resource Pack!

Including new custom item models for 4 all-new currencies, 5 seals, 5 writs, and a bowler hat!

These are custom models, and to be used with commands, specifically the new item_model component.

# Hats
- Bowler Hat (hats:bowler_hat)

# Seals
- Imperial Seal (isv:seal)
- Territories Seal (abt:seal)
- Regency Seal (brg:seal)
- Empery Seal (eme:seal)
- Republic Seal (rpb:seal)
